name: System E (provisional)
description: System D + trend-hold (no rank sale while the stock is above a rising 50-day EMA) + profit lock at +50% (instead of +30%). Each part was in the exp43 Bayesian test; the combination was spotted with knowledge of the check periods, so it is provisional. exp44: better than System D on starts 2000-11, 2012-19 and 2020-25. AUDIT 15 Oct 2026: pause signals now built from that day's S&P 500 members only (pit_signals); the earlier numbers used a turnover-ranked set that leaked future survivors.
